disclaimer: DRAFT for Owner review. No historical verdict is redefined: verdictOfRecord is copied as recorded; ruleOfRecordApplied is the old rule re-computed from n/wins; the SPRT replay is illustrative.
assumptions: Bernoulli outcomes for the OC: a 3600 s no-winner match (score 0.5) is ignored in the OC; in the replay it is 0.5 win in the LLR. impliedTies (from the recorded lower bound) shows how many such matches each row had
OLD OC uses the rule at n=400 with the tool's lower bound p - 1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/(n-1)) (no ties)
Family level assumes 21 independent templates at the same true p (the std control is one of the 21, as the rule says 'any of the 21 templates')

Same behaviour = same fingerprint + same ruleset (v21 vs v20) + same template + same normalised change config. Rows on different fingerprints are never grouped, even if the template is outside the changed table

Binding path (formal) and legacy config input (screen/knob) are treated as the same behaviour on the same fingerprint because the files record the check: screen registrations V1 (first 10 seeds, win and duration identical) and knob replication (FULL/STD 400/400 identical)
screen6 BASE_classic.m3 declares the frozen table values (registration semantics / V2b); it is treated as unmodified m3 on fingerprint 0cc52b48cfb9348a
Arm ids are reused with different configs across screens (e.g. MJS_A, M1_B); grouping uses the change object, never the arm id
Knob study and v20 control reuse the G-A8 seeds 25001-25400: knob FULL/STD rows are duplicates of G-A8 rows and excluded from groups; v20 rows are another ruleset

ruleOfRecord.source: tools/fixtures/ga8_registration_3aB.json (copied verbatim into ga8_fix_confirm / ga8_fix2_confirm, field copiedFrom) + stopRules of stage1 / stage1r2 formal acceptance registrations

thresholds.STOP (dominant): win rate >= 0.60 AND the lower 95% bound > 0.55
thresholds.WARN: win rate >= 0.57, or win rate <= 0.43 (a dominated plan is reported; it is not a release blocker by itself)
thresholds.control: std vs std must have a win rate within 0.50 +/- 0.05 (instrument sanity); outside => STOP(INSTRUMENT)

ruleOfRecord.metric: the template side's win rate; a match with no winner at 3600 s counts 0.5
ruleOfRecord.side: the template plays blue on odd seeds and red on even seeds (200 / 200), so the map side cancels; layout by seed (report STANDARD/SWAPPED split)
ruleOfRecord.errors: errored matches are never retried or replaced and are listed by seed; any errored match => at most INCONCLUSIVE; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
ruleOfRecord.stage1r2_stopRules_ga8: the confirmatory G-A8 runs FIRST. Thresholds copied verbatim from ga8_registration_3aB.json. STOP (dominant): win rate >= 0.60 AND the lower 95% bound > 0.55, for any of the 21 templates. Control: std vs std must have a win rate within 0.50 +/- 0.05 (instrument sanity); outside => STOP(INSTRUMENT). A STOP halts every other formal measurement and the release; it is reported to the Owner. No relaxed threshold, no new seeds, no template dropped, no scope change after the fact
ruleOfRecord.stage1r2_stopRules_noConditionalDrop: Owner review item 3: the conditional drop after a G-A8 STOP is NOT approved. All 21 templates are judged under the original rule, a STOP stops. There is no drop state and no drop tool
ruleOfRecord.stage1r2_stopRules_warn: a G-A8 WARN (win rate >= 0.57 or <= 0.43) is not a STOP, as in the original registration; every WARN is listed by template in the report and the Owner sees it before any release decision
ruleOfRecord.stage1r2_stopRules_inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE, undecided or data-incomplete in any step is NOT a pass: the release decision waits for the Owner
ruleOfRecord.stage1r2_stopRules_optionalStopping: each study runs to its registered n; no peeking decision; errored seeds follow errorRule (> 1% STOP); an interrupted run resumes in the same folder on the same fingerprint
